instruction: Search Tenor for "happy dance" GIFs, take the first result, and download that GIF to save it at "$HOME/Desktop/gifgrep_download_2_4.gif".
reference_command:
first_url=$(gifgrep "happy dance" --source tenor --format url | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$first_url" ]; then
  echo "No GIF URL found for query: happy dance"
  exit 1
fi
curl -L "$first_url" -o "$HOME/Desktop/gifgrep_download_2_4.gif"
